defects.finding: Architecture text normalized punctuation in requirement identifiers, but the evaluator searched for the original hyphenated identifiers.
defects.impact: Critical requirement and quality coverage were forced to zero for every mode even when exact requirement identifiers were present.
defects.repair: Normalize both the architecture text and each identifier before exact token-sequence matching.

defects.impact: Correctly rejected statements could be counted as accepted unsupported consequential claims.
defects.repair: Treat the ledger as rejection evidence; accepted unsupported claims remain an adversarial-review finding.
